constructionLineage.root: the pushed commit containing this authorization record

objective: v0.8 scheduled workflows and fleet automation per docs/roadmap.md section 0.8: persistent schedule definitions (cron and interval triggers), deterministic execution dispatch via FleetJobScheduler, persistent execution history, operator schedule controls, and auditability

must: RFC-first design record for scheduled workflows and fleet automation (RFC-0015) before product construction
persistent schedule storage in SQLite with atomic status transitions (active, paused, completed, error)
cron expression and interval parsing with timezone pinning and invalid schedule rejection
scheduling dispatch delegating strictly to RFC-0014 fleet execution without bypassing target validation
missed-run policy handling (skip vs immediate run) and execution window tracking
execution history and schedule run logs recording dispatch timeline and results
audit logging of schedule creation, pause, resume, mutation, deletion, and dispatch
candidate-freeze rule compliance and fresh candidate-bound evidence for the v0.8 release candidate
should: first-class Scheduled Workflows panel in the operator UI with cron schedule inspector and next-run timers
outOfScope: a new route authority system beyond RFC-0010
a new selector system beyond RFC-0011
a new DSH compatibility profile without a designed RFC and compliance with the DSH baseline promotion policy
tag or release creation/mutation without separate authorization

allowedPathRules: package.json: dependency changes require recorded justification
forbiddenActions: reopening or rewriting the accepted v0.7 closure lineage or its attestation
product construction before RFC-0015 and Stage 0 Gate A approval is recorded
changing the DSH baseline outside the DSH baseline promotion policy
tag or release creation/mutation without separate authorization

evidenceRequirements.candidateFreezeRule: exactly one frozen candidate per evidence round; once frozen, later phases produce only qualification/evidence; a real problem means a new candidate and fresh candidate-bound evidence
evidenceRequirements.scheduledWorkflowMatrixRequired: a dedicated scheduled workflow acceptance matrix must be defined in RFC-0015 and mechanically enforced before the v0.8 mounted evidence run
evidenceRequirements.closureRule: one evidence-only closure, direct child of the frozen candidate, attestation must not reference its own closure SHA
